_notes: Reviewed all 344 keys against the current English; none had a null cur. Kept keys are correct as they stand.
The English moved from dashes to full sentences in success/writing/concierge; the Chinese still had —— everywhere. Those keys were re-punctuated (，/。) to match, wording tightened where needed.

Team identity: 'Hangyul Univ 团队' changed to 'Hangyul 团队' where the English says 'the Hangyul team'. Where the current English says 'your counselor' (visaroute, success, concierge, writing), 你的顾问 is kept, as the English says. OWNER: the English mixes 'your counselor' and 'the Hangyul team' for the same person (e.g. success:owner.counselor = 'The Hangyul team'); if the student app should say team everywhere, fix the English first.
student:v9.sponsor.foot: the old Chinese added 所有决定均由大学和大使馆做出, which the English does not say; removed. Owner may want that disclaimer back in the English.
'change of status' in Korea = 变更滞留资格 (체류자격 변경), not 签证身份.
writing:dim.ANSWERS_PROMPT has no zh-Hans translation in packages/i18n (falls back to English); PROMPT_PART_MISSING quotes it as 回答了题目. Whoever translates the rubric should use exactly 回答了题目.
visaroute caveats render 'national (visa) manual' as 韩国法务部（签证）手册; accurate (the manual is the Ministry of Justice's) and kept.
Kept: plan = 服务方案, residence card = 外国人登录证, apostille 海牙认证, consular legalization 领事认证, admission letter 入学许可书 (the English here doesn't say 'standard').
